turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Khan from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Mr. Sameer from the RBI verification cell. I am calling regarding a pending KYC update for your savings account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: KYC? But I gave all my papers to the branch manager last year.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That was for the old system, ma'am. Now we have a new digital mandate and since yours is expired, your account will be blocked by tonight.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Blocked? Oh no, I have a payment of eighty thousand rupees to make for my grandson's college today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Exactly, that is why I am calling to help you. We can update it right now over the phone so your funds remain accessible.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, tell me what I need to do. How will we do it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is very simple. Please read out your sixteen digit debit card number and the expiry date first.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, is it safe to give the card number on the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am an official from the Reserve Bank, Mrs. Khan. Once you give the card number, I will send a verification OTP which you must tell me to complete the process.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am a bit confused, let me call my son first and ask him.
